body:
LlvmFnSig now records every declared parameter's own type, not just return type; a real call site checks both argument count and each argument's own type against the callee's declared signature. Found and fixed a real, previously-unnamed latent gap: argument count was never checked at all. Also closes the earlier-named 'bare literal call argument fails' gap since arguments now get the callee's declared type as their expected_type hint. 4 more real assertions (35 total). make test: 347/347; editor-demo, clang route, and direct-AVR route all re-verified end to end.

⚓ ☃
title: LLVM backend: real call argument-count/type validation added
